seleccionadas.titulo: This work expresses longing through memories of places once shared with friends. Pigeons, commonly seen in everyday life, represent myself and my friends, as they can remember places and find their way home, reflecting our memories of shared places and the possibility of reunion.  The reflection of the place appears above the image, distorted by ripples in the water. The unclear reflection represents how memories gradually fade and become blurred over time.
